description:
Demonstrated product development experience on Android and Windows
 Demonstrated software engineering practices such as design, documentation, prototype, code, and developer level testing
 Demonstrated mastery of Java, C/C++ and Android programming
 Demonstrated ability to make significant contributions to architecture and design documents
 Demonstrated mastery of object-oriented software design
 Must have solid development experience on various Media formats, H.264/AVC, Media Frameworks such as StageFright, Media Foundation and solid understanding of OpenMax IL standards
 Demonstrated working knowledge on streaming protocols such as RTP/RTSP/HTTP
 Comfortable programming at the middleware and device driver level and working on Android and Windows.
 Experience with or knowledge of various DRM schemes such as Widevine, PlayReady.
 Good team player, assertive, self-starter with a can-do-attitude and good communication (verbal and written) and organizational skills.
 Ability to analyze and break down problems
 Solid understanding of Intel architecture, and capabilities would be an added advantage - particularly around Intel® ATOM(TM).
 

 
 Good comm skills are a big priority 
 Duration: 6 Months extendable
